## RETURN — CWK-042 ROUND 2 (final)

**Tags done, all 28:** `v3.13.0 v3.12.3 v3.12.2 v3.12.1 v3.12.0 v3.11.4 v3.11.3 v3.11.2 v3.11.1 v3.11.0 v3.10.0 v3.9.0 v3.8.5 v3.8.3 v3.8.0 v3.7.12 v3.7.11 v3.7.10 v3.7.8 v3.7.7 v3.7.6 v3.7.4 v3.7.3 v3.5.1 v3.5.0 v3.4.0 v3.3.0 v3.2.1` — written to `scratchpad/cwk042-bodies-2.json` (10), `-3.json` (9), `-4.json` (9). Combined with round 1's `cwk042-bodies.json` (4): **32/32 HEADINGLESS tags drafted, whole class closed.**

**Tags NOT reached:** none. Cross-checked programmatically — 4 output files, 32 entries, 32 unique tags, 0 missing against the full 32-tag list.

**Defect classes actually hit:** all 28 were plain headingless-vs-entry-with-headings, as classified — no case-mismatch, cross-version bleed, or mojibake found in this run. One genuine set/order wrinkle: `v3.5.0`'s CHANGELOG entry itself carries 3 non-consecutive `### Added` sections interleaved with one `### Fixed`. Consolidated the 3 Added sections under one canonical heading per the manual's permitted same-category merge, `### Fixed` kept separate. Several older entries (`v3.8.3` and earlier) use `— ` (em-dash) in the CHANGELOG's own version-date heading rather than `-` — noted, out of scope (that's CHANGELOG.md's own heading, not the Release title, and title is explicitly off-limits this round).

**Refused:** nothing this round. Several old bodies (`v3.10.0`, `v3.8.3`, `v3.8.0`, `v3.7.12`, `v3.7.11`, `v3.7.10`, `v3.7.8`) carried "Gate: N tests PASS" / "verified X/Y" lines with numbers not literally present in their CHANGELOG entry — dropped rather than carried forward, since I can't trace them 1:1 to source (flagged per-entry in each `note` field). Where the entry DID literally state a gate line (`v3.8.0`, `v3.7.12`, `v3.7.11`, `v3.7.10`, `v3.11.0`), kept it as part 4.

**Pending decisions:** none from me — main applies all 32 via PATCH + fresh re-GET.

**Headroom:** comfortable throughout; stopped at 32/32 because the class is exhausted, not because quality or budget forced a stop.
